what_is.title: What Is PDF Merging?
what_is.description: PDF merging combines multiple PDF documents into a single organized file for easier sharing, printing, and document management. SafeTools allows you to arrange pages exactly how you need them.

how_it_works.title: How PDF Merging Works
how_it_works.note: Files are processed entirely inside your browser.

organize.title: Organize PDFs Before Merging
organize.subtitle: Prepare your perfect document with our visual studio tools:

secure.title: Secure PDF Handling
secure.description: We strictly enforce local memory processing. There is no server retention, meaning temporary handling ensures automatic cleanup the moment you close the tab.

privacy.description: Your files never leave your device. All merging and processing happen entirely in your browser using local resources, ensuring absolute privacy for your sensitive documents.

offline.title: Works Offline
offline.description: SafeTools features comprehensive PWA support. Experience true offline PDF merging with zero internet dependency and reduced data exposure.

formats.title: Supported Formats
formats.description: We don't just merge PDF files. SafeTools supports embedding various image formats directly into your document. Currently supported formats include PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WEBP. Images are automatically fitted to the page layout for a seamless reading experience.

limits.title: Zero File Size Limits
limits.description: Because everything happens in your local browser environment, there are no artificial file size limits. Merge 10MB or 1GB files without encountering paywalls or upload restrictions—your only limitation is your device's RAM capacity.

items.q: Is it safe to upload sensitive PDF documents?
items.a: With SafeTools, you never 'upload' your documents. All PDF operations—merging, splitting, compressing, or converting—happen locally on your computer. Your sensitive legal or financial documents stay private.

items.q: Can I merge different file types into a single PDF?
items.a: Yes, our PDF Merger allows you to combine multiple PDFs and various image formats (JPG, PNG, etc.) into one professional PDF document.

items.q: Does the PDF compressor reduce text quality?
items.a: Our compression engine is designed to optimize images and fonts within the PDF while keeping the text sharp and searchable. You can choose different compression levels based on your needs.
